Bereich zu verstärken, wird zum nächst gegebenen Zeitpunkt ein Senior Group Controller (m/w) gesucht, welcher sein weitreichendes Wissen gewinnbringend einsetzt und das Finance Umfeld weiter mit vorantreibt.Wenn Sie sich von dieser Position angesprochen fühlen, dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen.AufgabengebietTake ownership of financial reporting and accounting for two German holding companies.-Manage monthly and quarterly financial closings, including group reporting under HGB and US IFRS.-Prepare annual financial statements in accordance with HGB and reconcile them with IFRS group reporting requirements.-Manage the accounting and contractual documentation of intercompany transactions, including service agreements and intercompany loans.-Coordinate annual external audits and act as the primary point of contact for external auditors and Internal Audit.-Prepare German VAT returns for the VAT group and provide the necessary documentation to tax advisors for annual VAT compliance.-Coordinate corporate income tax returns for both holding companies and manage tax-related matters of the subsidiaries within the tax group, including coordination of tax payments.-Support tax audits and act as the key contact for tax advisors and tax auditors.-Act as Cash Pool Master, overseeing and further developing the cash pooling structure while managing liquidity and cash management activities.-Oversee intercompany financing activities, including loans and corporate bonds.-Execute payment transactions and manage relationships with banking partners.-Ensure compliance with statutory reporting obligations to the Deutsche Bundesbank.-Perform process controls and account reconciliations to ensure adherence to internal processes, group-wide financial policies and internal control frameworks (SOX)-Prepare and maintain transfer pricing documentation and ensure compliance with contractual transfer pricing requirements.-Support acquisitions by coordinating payment processes and integrating acquired entities into the holding companies' accounting structures.-Manage equity investments and related corporate law requirements, including notification obligations under the German Fiscal Code.-Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders across Treasury, Tax, Finance and Legal.AnforderungsprofilBachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics or a related field, with a focus on Financial Accounting, Business Taxation or Controlling.-At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in public accounting or auditing (preferably Big Four) or within the Finance & Accounting function of an international corporate group or holding structure.-Advanced knowledge of HGB and IFRS, including the ability to reconcile financial statements between both accounting standards.-Strong understanding of German tax regulations relevant to holding companies, particularly VAT, income tax groups (Organschaft) and transfer pricing.-Practical experience in Treasury, including cash pooling, intercompany financing and liquidity management; knowledge of Deutsche Bundesbank reporting requirements is an advantage.-Good understanding of internal control systems (IKS) and experience working with external auditors and tax authorities.-Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, as well as experience with ERP, consolidation and treasury systems.-Proven leadership skills, with the ability to guide, motivate and develop team members.-Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across different business functions.-Business-fluent in both written and spoken German and English.VergütungspaketAttraktives Vergütungspaket-Internationales Umfeld-Jegliche Benefits-Home Office MErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Buchführung, Buchhaltung, Compliance Management, Rechnungslegung nach HGB, International Accounting/Financial Reporting Standards (IAS/IFRS), Controlling, ZahlenverständnisErweiterte Kenntnisse: Präsentationsprogramm PowerPoint (MS Office), Tabellenkalkulation Excel (MS Office), Textverarbeitung Word (MS Office)
